grc:verb:βλέπομεν.gloss: first-person plural present active indicative of βλέπω (blépō)

grc:verb:ἔστε.gloss: up to the time that, until

grc:adv:ἔστε.gloss: up to the time that, until

grc:verb:ἕπεται.gloss: third-person singular present mediopassive indicative of ἕπομαι (hépomai)

grc:verb:ἐξέρχονται.gloss: third-person plural present mediopassive indicative of ἐξέρχομαι (exérkhomai)

grc:noun:περίσσωμα.gloss: that which is over and above

grc:noun:ἐφελκύσει.gloss: dative singular of ἐφέλκῠσῐς (ephélkŭsĭs, “attraction, appeal, pull, allure, magnetism; tendency to draw towards oneself, attract, amass; addition, annexation, affixation”)

grc:noun:ἐφελκύσι.gloss: dative singular of ἐφέλκῠσῐς (ephélkŭsĭs, “attraction, appeal, pull, allure, magnetism; tendency to draw towards oneself, attract, amass; addition, annexation, affixation”)

grc:verb:ἔρχεται.gloss: third-person singular present middle indicative of ἔρχομαι (érkhomai)

grc:verb:ἐξάρχω.gloss: begin, take the lead in, initiate

grc:verb:δύνανται.gloss: third-person plural present mediopassive indicative of δῠ́νᾰμαι (dŭ́nămai)

grc:noun:σώμασιν.gloss: dative plural of σῶμᾰ (sômă) with movable nu

grc:verb:ἔγνωμεν.gloss: first-person plural aorist active indicative of γιγνώσκω (gignṓskō)

grc:conj:ὥστε.gloss: so that, with the result that

grc:adv:ὥστε.gloss: so that, with the result that

grc:noun:ὕδασιν.gloss: dative plural of ῠ̔́δωρ (hŭ́dōr) with movable nu

grc:noun:λιπαρόν.gloss: an oily or fatty substance; especially greasy or fatty food

grc:verb:δύναται.gloss: third-person singular present mediopassive indicative of δῠ́ναμαι (dŭ́namai)

grc:adv:αὐτίκα.gloss: forthwith, at once, in a moment

grc:verb:φαίνεται.gloss: third-person singular present mediopassive indicative of φαίνω (phaínō)

grc:adv:ἐμποδών.gloss: before the feet, in the way, in one's path

grc:adv:κοινῶς.gloss: in common, jointly, opposite to ἰδίᾳ

grc:verb:ᾖ.gloss: third-person singular present active subjunctive of εἰμί (eimí)

grc:verb:βοηθέω.gloss: come to aid, succour, assist, aid

grc:verb:κατέχει.gloss: third-person singular imperfect active indicative contracted of καταχέω (katakhéō)

grc:verb:πάσχει.gloss: third-person singular present active indicative of πᾰ́σχω (pắskhō)

grc:verb:τρέχει.gloss: third-person singular present active indicative of τρέχω (trékhō)

grc:verb:πνέωσιν.gloss: third-person plural present active subjunctive of πνέω (pnéō)

grc:verb:ποιῶσι.gloss: contracted third-person plural present active subjunctive of ποιέω (poiéō)

grc:noun:ἐφέλκυσιν.gloss: accusative singular of ἐφέλκῠσῐς (ephélkŭsĭs, “attraction, appeal, pull, allure, magnetism; tendency to draw towards oneself, attract, amass; addition, annexation, affixation”)

grc:verb:βιάζομαι.gloss: to use force; to apply force

grc:noun:δυσμαί.gloss: nominative/vocative plural of δῠσμή (dŭsmḗ, “setting of the sun; sunset; region where the Sun sets; the west, occident”)

grc:noun:δυσμάς.gloss: accusative plural of δῠσμή (dŭsmḗ, “setting of the sun; sunset; region where the Sun sets; the west, occident”)

grc:noun:πόρος.gloss: means of passing a river, ford, ferry

grc:verb:πόροι.gloss: third-person singular aorist active optative of ἔπορον (époron)

grc:verb:ἠρεμέω.gloss: to be still, keep quiet, be at rest

grc:noun:νῆμα.gloss: that which is spun, thread, yarn

grc:noun:χρυσῖτις.gloss: flake litharge, a silver ore also containing traces of gold

grc:pron:ἄ.gloss: oxytone form of ᾱ̓ (ā, feminine nominative singular of ὀ (o, Cretan and Lesbian form of ὁ (ho, relative pronoun)))

grc:noun:ἐφελκύσεως.gloss: genitive singular of ἐφέλκῠσῐς (ephélkŭsĭs, “attraction, appeal, pull, allure, magnetism; tendency to draw towards oneself, attract, amass; addition, annexation, affixation”)

grc:noun:ἐφελκύσιος.gloss: genitive singular of ἐφέλκῠσῐς (ephélkŭsĭs, “attraction, appeal, pull, allure, magnetism; tendency to draw towards oneself, attract, amass; addition, annexation, affixation”)

grc:verb:στερίσκω.gloss: synonym of στερέω (steréō), used only in the present

grc:verb:ἐκβαίνει.gloss: third-person singular present active indicative of ἐκβαίνω (ekbaínō)

grc:noun:οὖ.gloss: Old name of the letter ο (omicron, see ὂ μικρόν (ò mikrón), όμικρον).

grc:verb:χρῶνται.gloss: third-person plural present mediopassive indicative/subjunctive of χράω (khráō)

grc:verb:ἐκπορεύω.gloss: make to go out, fetch out

grc:noun:ὀξεῖα.gloss: oxia (the acute accent, indicating high or rising pitch)

grc:verb:πίπτει.gloss: third-person singular present active indicative of πῑ́πτω (pī́ptō)

grc:verb:ἀρκῶν.gloss: present active participle contracted of ἀρκέω (arkéō)

grc:verb:ἐδείξαμεν.gloss: first-person plural aorist active indicative of δείκνῡμι (deíknūmi)

grc:verb:στρέφεται.gloss: third-person singular present mediopassive indicative of στρέφω (stréphō)

grc:verb:ἐπακολουθέω.gloss: follow close upon, follow after, pursue
